# Independent FITS/WCS reference files

Copied unmodified from the astropy repository, tag v7.0.1 (commit c1bf7267dbc19c0bc38cace4ec9b4f19108e7561), under the BSD-3-Clause license in LICENSE.rst.
They were written by astropy/cfitsio/wcslib or by other missions' software, not by Skytrace, and are used only as test inputs.
Expected values in tests/unit/test_fits_wcs_external.py are transcribed from astropy's own tests (cited per test).
